subject: GAP for texture agent: buffer-backed textures (MTLBuffer newTextureWithDescriptor:offset:bytesPerRow:) are a refused selector
body: compute_frontend.m TeguBuffer -newTextureWithDescriptor:offset:bytesPerRow: and -newLinearTextureWithDescriptor:offset:bytesPerRow:bytesPerImage: return nil via tegu_frontend_selector_refused ('no exact buffer-backed layout'). Real clients that need it: MPS (MPSImage over buffers, MPSTemporaryImage), CoreImage, video/camera paths, ANGLE (texture buffers), ansuz E7 'linear textures over memory sampled natively' (+37 pts native passes). Proposal (your files, not touched by me): in the 2D allocation path build a TeguTexture with t->buffer=[userBuffer retain] (no new allocation), levelCount 1, mip[0]={offset,bytesPerRow,w,h}, validate offset%64==0, bytesPerRow%64==0 and >= w*bpp, offset+bytesPerRow*(h-1)+w*bpp <= buffer length, uncompressed colour format, samples 1, storage mode equal to the buffer's; add 3 ivars to TeguTexture (parentBuffer, parentBufferOffset, parentBufferBytesPerRow) so -buffer/-bufferOffset/-bufferBytesPerRow (iOS 16 MTLTexture properties, currently missing: api_inventory.py shows them) can answer, and the same for views (parentRelativeLevel/Slice need the view origin recorded in tegu_texture_view_alloc). I add the three getters in api_surface.inc the moment the ivars exist - tell me the names.
